Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge, climb animations, wall risers, research gating, PS + TO support, global click-through. W12-15 SHIPPED; §94 PUBLISHED; W18 GL/MapPreview repair FIELD-VERIFIED. W19: §99 BAND DRESSING FIELD-VERIFIED — features, biome-parity flora, per-band rock/gravel/terrain, landmark mutators on every level, plus a 7x ground-level scatter bug fixed.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> **⚠⚠ V1 SOURCE IS NOT GONE: `D:\Rimworld\As above, So below\<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>\Source\`** (ten snapshots, newest `20260726-154207`). READ THE V1 FILE FIRST when a V2 feature has an ancestor. `read` refuses that path; `bash`/`grep`/`sed` reach it.

# 0. START HERE — WINDOW 19

**WINDOW 18 IN ONE PARAGRAPH.** Audit + optimization (§98), then GL + Map Preview compat. The entire Map Preview bridge had been dead for versions — `Resolve()` threw on its second statement. Repaired; landform chain FIELD-VERIFIED at #508. §96's water fix shipped but its A/B did not discriminate (§96.e).

**WINDOW 19 — §99 BAND DRESSING, SHIPPED AND FIELD-VERIFIED.** User report: non-surface bands devoid of chunks, features and biome-density vegetation, plus two exclusion rules (anima + ancient wreckage = ground level only). Tier 1 verified across #512/#514/#515. A LavaField follow-up ("normal stone, not biome + mod aware") added **A/A2/B1/C/D**, verified at **#517** on an `AB_OcularForest` tile — user: "This all works." **⚠ Two fixes made AFTER that verdict are untested, and one of them CHANGES what the user approved — see §99.n.**

**⚠⚠ WINDOW 19 NEXT MOVES, IN ORDER:**
1. **⚠⚠ §99.n — RE-VERIFY THE POST-#517 FIXES.** The palette-divergence fix deliberately changes basement stone from the random roll the user saw to the tile's rock. Cheap: one Alpha Biomes colony, check `FillRock band 0` is back near ~2.4 s and the basement reads as the tile's stone.
2. **THE PUBLISH PASS** (§31) — carries §94 docs debt + §95 + §87.b + §96 + §98 + §99. Nothing pushed since `f2939e1`; w17-w19 in autosaves only. ⚠ §96 wording caveat (§96.e). ⚠ §99's ground-level count fix is the most user-visible line in the release.
3. **⚠ §95.j static flecks + ABWaterLab — STILL UNTESTED** (w17 carry-over).
4. **⚠ INSTRUMENTATION POLICY DECISION (ask the user)** — rules 64/5. Asked w15, w16; unanswered.
5. **⚠ §99.l `CanReachMapEdge` GAP** — a whole CLASS of foreign genstep silently produces nothing in a sealed basement band.
6. **⚠ THE CARVE IS THE REAL GENERATION BILL** — ledger 10.
7. Standing queue: E3 (§95.i), §88 CE (queued five windows), §89 (ruling first), §97 parked.

**✅ SHIPPED/LIVE:** w12-15 on Workshop 3776015553 (w15 `f2939e1`); §94 published user-solo. THE WORKSPACE DLL IS A DEBUG BUILD — NORMAL (`#if DEBUG` is the off switch; DECOMPILE TO PROVE at publish, rule 17/64).

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked — scans COMPAT ONLY; V1 exempt. (2) Building art = USER. (3) About description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N choices. (5) NO NEW INSTRUMENTATION WITHOUT ASKING. (6) A user deferral is a ruling. **(7) THE USER MAY CLOSE AN INVESTIGATION ON "IT WORKS" — record the residual uncertainty and move on.**

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (standing):** §91.c DORMANT; §90 elevator-fallback + walled-front-tile; §85 flipped up-link approachCells; §62.N, §70; §62.M, §66c, §66e. **⚠ VERIFIED-WITH-CAVEAT:** §94.g FLIP; §96 square `_MapSize` (§96.e); **§99.C (exercised, never independently confirmed — §99.m)**. **⚠ BUILT-UNTESTED:** **§99.n's two post-verdict fixes**; §95.j seam fix + ABWaterLab (w17); §56p; §98's C-items. **✅ FIELD-VERIFIED:** §56q/§56n/§56m/§56r + MapPreviewCompat (#508); §99 Tier 1 (#512/#514/#515) and §99 A/A2/B1/D (#517).

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE RULES (headline forms; unabridged pre-w17 revs):** 1 CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2 NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3 FLOOD CELLS. 4 COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/STACKS. 5 A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP. 7 THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 A REPAIR PASS MUST NOT RE-CREATE DELIBERATE REMOVALS. 9 SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 A CELL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN ACTION. 12 A FOREIGN SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 ASK WHAT IS AT THE DESTINATION. 15 ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 COUNT THE WRITE PATHS. 17 A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX + decompile the binary. 18 NEVER EXONERATE ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 `TicksGame` RESTARTS. 20 EARLIER WORK TURNS ON EVERY READINESS GATE. 21 THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL. 22 A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN. 23 AUDIT THE WEIGHTING. 24 CLAMP THE TARGET TOO. 25 A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS TOO LATE. 26 PASS THE RENDERER'S GATE. 27 SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 A FICTION FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS FACT TO THE REST. 29 REPORT OUTCOMES. 30 A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN. 31 MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE. 32 A TICK CARRIES SERVICES. 33 A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 INVISIBLE = ABSENT FROM EVERY LAYER. 35 A CLONED DEF IS IN NO LOOKUPS. 36 RUN VANILLA'S PREDICATE. 37 NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT. 38 OWN THE DRAW — AT THE FUNNEL. 39 LAST WRITE ≠ SETTLED TARGET. 40 A TRIPWIRE BEFORE THE OBSERVER IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 AN UNSET FIELD IS AN UNSHIPPED FEATURE. 42 READ-DIRECTION IS THE THING'S PROPERTY. 43 DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION. 44 A WHOLE OFFSET ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT. 45 TRAVEL ≠ ELEVATION. 46 SCALE × ROTATION = SHEAR. 47 A CACHED CURSOR CELL IS A COORDINATE ASSUMPTION. 48 A WRITE READ BACK BY ITS CALLER IS NOT A WRITE. 49 A TEST FOR A SAYS NOTHING ABOUT B. 50 TWO OWN PATCHES CANCEL SILENTLY. 51 A FACTORY CONSUMED ITS INPUT. 52 AN OVERLAY ASKS THE CLICK'S QUESTION, READ-ONLY. 53 A PREDICATE IS CLOSED OVER ITS CALLER'S ARGS. 54 SEARCH THE CAPABILITY. 55 FALLBACK JOBS COUNT. 56 RANK-VS-FILTER FINDS THE BLIND SPOT. 57 TWO "WHICH SIDE" ANSWERS = ONE WRONG. 58 ART ≠ DEF. 59 MEASURE size FROM THE DRAWING. 60 MEASURE THE PIXELS. 61 A COLOURED GRAPHIC IS A DIFFERENT OBJECT. 62 FINISHED-ANSWER TABLES ROT. 63 MEASURE PATIENCE FROM ITS EVENT. 64 OFF-BY-DEFAULT DIAGNOSTICS DON'T EXIST. 65 THE FOURTH FAILURE IS A DEFECTIVE INPUT. 66 A DESTINATION DOESN'T CONSTRAIN ENTRY SIDE. 67 ASK WHO SENT THE NEW ORDER. 68 TWICE ON ONE DEF = THE DEF'S RULE. 69 SUSPENDING A DRIVER INHERITS ITS REQUESTS. 70 OPT-IN AT N CONSUMERS = WRONG LAYER. 71 "THE" OCCUPANT CANNOT SEE A STACK. 72 A NAMED-BUILDING DESTINATION OUTLIVES CORRECTIONS. 73 A PROBE COMPUTING ITS OWN ANSWER ISN'T READING. 74 NAME THE DENOMINATOR. 75 CROSS-BAND LENGTH PRICES NORTH AS UP. 76 VERIFY THE WINNER. 77 A REVERTED FIX MAY HAVE BEEN CORRECT ARITHMETIC ON A POISONED INPUT. 78 ONE `try` AROUND N LOOKUPS MAKES N FEATURES ONE FEATURE. 79 A HOST THAT SKIPS GENSTEPS GIVES ITS GUESTS DIFFERENT FACTS. 80 A FIX THAT CANNOT BE SWITCHED OFF AGAIN IS A FIX YOU CANNOT ATTRIBUTE.
**⚠ 81 (w19) A DIMENSION THE ENGINE NEVER READS CANNOT PROTECT YOU.** `CountFromPer10kCells` squares `map.Size.x` and never touches `Size.z`/`map.Area`.
**⚠ 82 (w19) TO INHERIT A MOD'S CONTENT, RUN ITS CODE, NOT ITS DEFS.** ReGrowth's boulders are a TRANSPILER on `GenStep_RockChunks`; Alpha Biomes patches `GrowLowRockFormationFrom` and `CanEverPlantAt`.
**⚠ 83 (w19) LIE ABOUT THE MAP AT THE THREE CELL FUNNELS, NOT AT THE CALLERS.** `Map.AllCells`, `cellsInRandomOrder.GetAll()`, `GenStep_Scatterer.TryFindScatterCell`.
**⚠ 84 (w19) TAKING OVER A JOB INHERITS ITS PRECONDITIONS, NOT ITS GUARDS.** Vanilla's plant spawner has no `Standable` test; ours did (§99.h).
**⚠ 85 (w19) A NAME-BASED WHITELIST CANNOT BE MOD-AWARE.** Alpha Biomes ships 12 TileMutatorWorkers and none match a vanilla name. Default to RUN, blocklist the unsafe, put a GUARD under it.
**⚠ 86 (w19) A SUBCLASS INHERITS THE PATCH YOU PUT ON ITS BASE.** `TileMutatorWorker_TarLakes : TileMutatorWorker_Lake`, so our surface-band `GetLakeCenter` pin applies — running it on another band yields a SILENT NO-OP that looks like a working feature. Block by TYPE, not name.
**⚠ 87 (w19) VERIFY THE DLC/COMPANION SET IS ACTUALLY ACTIVE BEFORE TRUSTING A NEGATIVE RESULT.** Three runs reported `0 mutator run(s)` as if it were data; Odyssey was never in `activeMods`. READ ModsConfig.xml — Mountain/Caves are CORE mutators and fooled me into thinking Odyssey was on.
**⚠⚠ 88 (w19) DIVERGENCE MUST BE REQUESTED, NEVER INCIDENTAL.** Re-deriving a value for a scope that never asked for one is not "more correct" — it is a cache-miss generator. A random per-band rock palette for a biome with no rock opinion cost **11 seconds** of generation time by defeating a keep-if-equal shortcut (§99.n). Before diverging from an inherited value, ask whether the new scope ACTUALLY specifies something different.
**⚠ 89 (w19) A COUNT THAT INCLUDES NO-OPS CANNOT ANSWER THE QUESTION IT EXISTS FOR.** "3 mutator run(s)" was three calls to an empty base method. Check the worker overrides the hook before calling and counting it (rule 29/74).

# 99. BAND DRESSING — EVERY LEVEL IS A REAL LEVEL — **FIELD-VERIFIED**

**99.a THE REPORT.** "Upper bands (and lower) devoid of rock chunks, vegetation (too sparse for biome) and features (lakes, vents, etc) including Odyssey landmarks and Vanilla Landmarks Expanded. Steam Geysers, Helixian Gas Vents, and Boulders from Regrowth 2. Anima trees should be level bounded to the ground level, and ancient wreckage, including from mods like Vanilla Vehicles Expanded and Vehicle Framework or the vanilla Mechanitor should never spawn in lower levels." **Follow-up:** "the LavaField has normal stone and not biome + mod aware. We should be respect of modded rock, biomes, and tilesets and allow them to still generate." **User rulings:** flora = vanilla's own pass, PARITY (drop the alpine rim curve); features = GENERALISE; landmarks = option B → later inverted to a blocklist (D); wreckage = ground level ONLY, props + mechanitor; then "A + A2 + B1, D with edge guard and C".

**99.b DIAGNOSIS (Tier 1) — THREE CAUSES.** (1) The carve is total and runs last; nothing re-placed what it erased. (2) `Patch_WildPlantSpawner_ABSkipDoomedBands` suppressed the initial plant pass on doomed bands, leaving band flora at our constants (sky `0.16 × plantDensity` thinned to ×0.30 by the alpine rim curve; cavern `0.08`). (3) **⚠⚠ The GROUND level was short too** — `CountFromPer10kCells` squares `Size.x`, so a 126×126 count was sprayed over seven bands. **Rule 81.**

**99.c MECHANISM — `ABBandScope`.** Three cell funnels (rule 83): `Map.AllCells` (prefix → band `CellRect`), `MapCellsInRandomOrder.GetAll` (postfix → band-filtered shuffle), `GenStep_Scatterer.TryFindScatterCell` (prefix → sample the band, call the instance's OWN `CanScatterAt` virtually, rule 36). Veto half lives INSIDE `Patch_GenStep_Scatterer_ABBandSeam` (rule 50). Single-slot; nested Push is a hard error; `AssertNoneOutstanding` shouts on leak. Sweep budget = 2 per `Generate` (rule 74).

**99.d TIER 1 SHIPPED.** `ABBandDressing.Dress` from the tail of `CarveInner` — after `CarveGutters`, before the basement refog, **under `CarveInProgress`** (else `ABAirSpawnGuard` walks every geyser back upstairs, as it walked 18,075 basement rocks at run #46, §57). Genstep capture reads `GenerateContentsIntoMap`'s ARGUMENT. Eligibility = capability → shape → names: `GenStep_RockChunks` (vanilla loose rock AND ReGrowth 2's boulders via their transpiler) plus any `GenStep_Scatterer` that is not `isJunk`, not `nearPlayerStart`/`nearMapCenter`. Flora = vanilla's `CheckSpawnWildPlantAt` with real density and whole-map demand, **both read OUTSIDE every scope**, **no scope armed during the flora pass**. `Patch_GenStep_ABSurfaceBandScope` confines the ORIGINAL pass to the surface band. `ABGroundOnly` pins special trees via `GenStep_SpecialTrees.CanSpawnAt` — **the anima INCIDENT path was covered by nothing before**.

**99.e TIER 1 VERIFICATION — #512/#514/#515.** #512 (2u/0d): `8 genstep run(s), 349 thing(s), 9,619 plant(s)`; dressing 1,057 ms; user "It feels good". #514 (2u/1d): basement dressed; **void flora guard exercised — 20,807 and 32,049 open-air cells skipped**. #515: band 3 vanilla pass placed **0**, **the zero-yield fallback fired** and seeded 657 plants across 4,162 plateau cells (rule 33 in the field); band 2 got 10,765. No scope leak, no wreckage audit warning, no exception.
**⚠ BENIGN LOG LINES — DO NOT RE-DIAGNOSE:** `ScatterCaveDebris found no legal cell` on sky bands (no cave) AND basement bands (§99.l). `AncientJunkClusters found no legal cell` in the surface band. **⚠ `airRejections` reads near-zero and that is EXPECTED** — vanilla's `CanScatterAt` rejects void cells on `spotMustBeStandable` first.

**99.i THE LAVAFIELD FOLLOW-UP — A, A2, B1, C, D.**
- **A — PER-BAND ROCK (`ABBandRocks.cs`).** Re-asks vanilla's question with the BAND's biome. **⚠ See §99.n: divergence is now REQUESTED-ONLY.** Palette caches rocks+noises as a PAIR (rule 16), `Reset()`s per carve (rule 21). `AllRocksOnMap` unions across bands for the mountain-cap renderer (rule 34).
- **A2 — BIOME GRAVEL.** `biomeDef.gravelTerrain ?? Gravel` in `ABBandedGeneration:853`, `ABCavernGen:221`, `ABSkyBandGen:213/217/231`, `Building_ABStairs2:468`. **Also fixed: `ABSkyBandGen` computed `ArableTerrainFor(map.Biome)` — the tile's answer — now the band's.**
- **B1 — BIOME TERRAIN (`ABBandBiomeTerrain.cs`).** Replays `biome.terrainPatchMakers` per band. **Additive**: skips stone-category and water cells exactly as `TileMutatorWorker_Patches` does. **⚠ No band-local noise wrap, deliberately** — `Init` re-seeds from `Rand.Range` and caches on the SHARED def, so bands naturally differ AND we MUST `Cleanup()` in a `finally` or the field leaks into the next map (rule 51).
- **C — BAND-AWARE BIOME DURING TERRAIN DRAW (`ABBandSectionBiome.cs`).** ReGrowth selects biome-specific terrain MATERIALS via `BiomeDef biome = map.Biome` — map-level, so every band drew as the surface. **⚠ Not fixable at their call site: `TerrainGrid.GetMaterial(TerrainDef, bool, ColorDef)` TAKES NO CELL.** Fixed at the funnel (rule 38): bracket `SectionLayer_Terrain.Regenerate` (sole caller, has cells) and redirect the `Map.Biome` getter for that call. **Names no third-party type.** ⚠ A 17-cell section can straddle a 192-row slot; the section centre decides. Fine for a texture swap; **do not reuse this scope for gameplay.**
- **D — BLOCKLIST INVERSION + WIDENED EDGE GUARD.** Whitelist was three vanilla names; **Alpha Biomes ships 12 workers, none matching** (rule 85). Default RUN; blocked: coast/river/island geography, cave/elevation shape, **`Landform` (GL — §56r's borrow is not in effect post-carve)**, man-made/ancient, biome-authorship (`MixedBiome` fights ABBandEnv). **⚠ Lake family blocked BY TYPE — rule 86.** Edge guard widened from `IsWater` to `IsWater || avoidWander || Impassable`, because `AB_LiquidLava` sets `avoidWander` and is not water (rule 54).

**99.j ⚠⚠ THE THREE WASTED RUNS.** #514/#515/#516 reported `0 mutator run(s)` and I read it as data. Odyssey was never in `activeMods`, and every Odyssey worker hard-gates on `ModsConfig.OdysseyActive`. It also explains the "vanilla debug menu bug" (empty `LandmarkDef` submenu → `children` null → `Enter` NREs). **I was fooled because `mutators: Mountain, Caves` are CORE.** Rule 87.
